definitions.latency: Mean of fit-specific medians of 20 repeats, after three warmups, on the first context; archive build plus four requests.
definitions.metric_means: Equal mean of three cohort scores, not ensemble predictions.
definitions.metric_points: Each point is one cohort's mean across three inherited fits; True GP has one reference.
definitions.pairwise: Mean identity-weight L1 from each approximation to full GP with the same fitted kernel; True GP is not that reference.
definitions.scope: Presentation-only scalar averages. No training, architecture novelty, calibration or general speed claim.
definitions.units: Stored seconds are unchanged. Only the latency figure converts them to milliseconds.

registered_result.scope: Established covariance approximation diagnostic; no novel architecture or parent rescue.
